figure: Physical KUKA iDo move from rest, requested speed 0.2 m/s, alternating directions, 22 repetitions. Figure 5.7 prints one integer-millisecond label for each ROS command-to-first-odometry-change interval, pp. 39. All 22 graph annotations were recovered from the fixed PDF and visually read back. Median of printed labels 56.5 ms, range 26 to 88 ms, mean 53.8182 ms. Thesis prose gives approximate median 55 ms. These are the authors’ plotted numbers, not independent processing of the original bags.
video_evidence: §5.2.5 and Figs. 5.6/5.9 use video at 240 frames/s (nominal frame separation about 4.17 ms) to mark first button press, LED indication of controller receipt and first visible robot motion. Approximate medians about 62 ms button-to-LED and 82 ms button-to-motion; latter IQR about 22 ms, one trial above 140 ms. The 22 individual LED and motion values are not recovered. Do not subtract the separate marginal medians to estimate a paired mechanical delay. The paper concludes that delay remains below 100 ms, but its analysis explicitly identifies one exception. ROS commands and video-origin delays have different start and end events.
